description: This file extends the AttributedString class with a method to extract sentences, potentially split into smaller segments based on maximum length, and associate audio time ranges. It leverages natural language processing via NLTokenizer to identify sentences and words, and uses AVFoundation's CMTimeRange to attach timing metadata.

classes.name: AttributedString
classes.description: An extension of the Swift AttributedString class providing sentence segmentation with optional length constraints and audio timing annotation.

methods.name: sentences(maxLength:)
methods.description: Returns an array of AttributedString segments representing sentences (or smaller parts if maxLength is specified), with associated audio time ranges embedded as attributes.
